---
title: "How does varying wing dihedral change glide ratio and lateral-directional stability?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 105.6      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Execute dihedral sweep using analysis helper
dihedrals = np.array([0.0, 1.5, 3.0, 4.5, 6.0])
trade = dihedral_trade(airplane, dihedrals_deg=dihedrals, mass=flight_mass_props.mass)

d_min = float(trade["dihedrals_deg"][0])
d_max = float(trade["dihedrals_deg"][-1])
base_i = int(np.argmin(np.abs(trade["dihedrals_deg"] - 3.0)))
d_base = float(trade["dihedrals_deg"][base_i])

ld_min_d = float(trade["max_LD"][-1])
ld_max_d = float(trade["max_LD"][0])
ld_base = float(trade["max_LD"][base_i])
delta_ld = float(ld_min_d - ld_max_d)
pct_ld = float(delta_ld / ld_max_d * 100)

clb_0 = float(trade["Cl_beta"][0])
clb_base = float(trade["Cl_beta"][base_i])
clb_6 = float(trade["Cl_beta"][-1])

cnb_0 = float(trade["Cn_beta"][0])
cnb_base = float(trade["Cn_beta"][base_i])
cnb_6 = float(trade["Cn_beta"][-1])

dClb_dgamma = float((clb_6 - clb_0) / (d_max - d_min))
ratio_base = float(-clb_base / cnb_base)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{dClb_dgamma:.4f} /rad/°"`]{.hero-value}
[roll stability sensitivity dCl_beta/dGamma at less than 0.1% glide loss per degree]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Sweeping wing dihedral from [`{python} f"{d_min:.1f}°"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{d_max:.1f}°"`]{.key} strengthens roll restoring stability ([`{python} f"{dClb_dgamma:.4f} /rad/°"`]{.key}) by [`{python} f"{clb_6 / clb_0:.1f}×"`]{.key} (@fig-dihedral-trade). Roll derivative $C_{l_\beta}$ scales from [`{python} f"{clb_0:.4f} /rad"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{clb_6:.4f} /rad"`]{.key}. Directional stability $C_{n_\beta}$ declines mildly from [`{python} f"{cnb_0:.4f} /rad"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{cnb_6:.4f} /rad"`]{.key}. Best glide ratio drops by only [`{python} f"{abs(delta_ld):.2f}"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{abs(pct_ld):.2f}%"`]{.key}) due to cosine span loss. The [calibrated baseline](2026-09-30-02-does-the-reconstructed-discus-2c-achieve-its-published-45-9-glide-rati.qmd) at [`{python} f"{d_base:.1f}°"`]{.key} achieves best L/D of [`{python} f"{ld_base:.1f}"`]{.key} and balanced stability coupling ($-C_{l_\beta}/C_{n_\beta} =$ [`{python} f"{ratio_base:.2f}"`]{.key}).

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **dihedral range: 0° to 6°**, design trade space.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-dihedral-trade
#| fig-cap: "Variation of best glide ratio, roll stability derivative Cl_beta, and directional stability derivative Cn_beta with wing dihedral angle for the calibrated Discus-2c."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 4))

ax1.plot(trade["dihedrals_deg"], trade["max_LD"], "bo-", label="Best L/D (AeroBuildup)")
ax1.plot(d_base, ld_base, "rs", markersize=7, label=f"Baseline Γ={d_base:.1f}°")
ax1.set_xlabel("Wing dihedral angle Γ [deg]")
ax1.set_ylabel("Best glide ratio (L/D)")
ax1.set_ylim(43.5, 45.0)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)

ax2.plot(trade["dihedrals_deg"], trade["Cl_beta"], "g^-", label="Roll stability $C_{l_\\beta}$ (/rad)")
ax2.plot(trade["dihedrals_deg"], trade["Cn_beta"], "mD-", label="Yaw stability $C_{n_\\beta}$ (/rad)")
ax2.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
ax2.plot(d_base, clb_base, "rs", markersize=6)
ax2.plot(d_base, cnb_base, "rs", markersize=6)
ax2.set_xlabel("Wing dihedral angle Γ [deg]")
ax2.set_ylabel("Stability derivatives [1/rad]")
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="center left", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
